app_tagline: Link your Minecraft profile and see how much time you have really spent on our servers.
landing_body: Sign in with your smto.dev account, link your Minecraft profile, and everything our servers record about you lands here. Linking works either through Microsoft or with a code you type in game.
landing_noAccount: No smto.dev account yet? You can create one during sign in.
landing_statsBody: Playtime, blocks mined, distance walked, mobs fought and whatever our plugins start counting next, totalled across every server you play on.
landing_boardsBody: One board per metric, network wide, so you can see who is ahead and how far off it you are.
landing_servicesBody: The launcher, the media uploader and your account settings are all a click away once you are signed in, with no second password anywhere.
dashboard_notLinkedBody: Link a profile and your playtime across every smto.dev server shows up here.
leaderboards_intro: Who is ahead across the whole network, counted across every server. A checkmark means the player has linked their Minecraft profile here. Everybody else is listed under the name Mojang has for them.
leaderboards_emptyBody: Nothing has been recorded so far. Join a server and the boards fill up within a few minutes.
leaderboards_emptyOnServer: Nothing has been recorded on {server} yet.
bubble_hint: Shown next to your character for everyone who opens your profile.
profile_notLinked: This player has not linked their account yet. Their numbers are counted anyway, and the name comes from Mojang.
profile_noStatsBody: {name} has not been seen on any of our servers yet.
dashboard_noStatsOnServer: You have nothing recorded on {server} yet.
dashboard_noStatsBody: Join one of our servers and your playtime will appear here within a few minutes.
link_intro: Two ways to do this. Both prove the profile is really yours, so pick whichever is easier for you.
link_msaBody: Sign in with the Microsoft account you own Minecraft on. Nothing about that account is stored: we read your profile once and keep only your username and UUID.
link_msaDisabled: Microsoft linking is not set up on this server right now. Use the in-game code instead.
link_codeBody: Get a code here, join any smto.dev server, and type it in chat. Our servers already check who you are when you join, so that is proof enough.
link_codeInstructions: Join a server and type this in chat:
link_success: {username} is now linked to your account.
settings_unlinkWarning: Your statistics are kept, and you stay on the leaderboards, just without the checkmark. Link the same profile again and it all comes back.
servers_archivedBody: Servers the network has closed. Nothing is deleted when one shuts down, so whatever you did there is still on record and still counts towards your totals.
servers_archivedEmpty: Nothing has been archived yet. Every server on the network is still going.
server_noStatsBody: Nobody has been seen on this server yet. Numbers appear a few minutes after the first player joins.
server_statsCombined: Added up across every player who has been seen here ({count}).
webmap_body: Explore the world of a server in your browser. Pick a server to open its map.
webmap_empty: None of our servers has a web map right now.
schematics_body: Converts structure files and Create schematics from Minecraft 1.21.11 (Create Fly) to 1.20.1 (Create Fabric 6.0.8). Everything happens in your browser, so your files are never uploaded.
schematics_note: Not everything survives the trip. Programs of the Sequenced Gearshift, the attributes of Attribute Filters and most entities cannot be converted. The report on each file lists what was changed and what was dropped.
schematics_needsJs: This converter runs in your browser and needs JavaScript. Turn it on for this site and reload the page.
schematics_optionsHint: Changing an option converts your files again.
schematics_opt_keepCreate: Keep and convert Create block entity data
schematics_opt_keepContainers: Keep the contents of vanilla containers
schematics_opt_convertMods: Convert block entities from other mods
schematics_opt_convertModsHint: Otherwise they are reduced to their id.
schematics_opt_dropKineticHint: Source, network and speed. Create recalculates them once the schematic is placed.
schematics_opt_unknownAir: Replace vanilla blocks that are missing in 1.20.1 with air
schematics_opt_unknownAirHint: Otherwise they are only reported, and Minecraft loads them as air anyway.
schematics_previewSummary: Preview the converted NBT as text
schematics_previewFailed: The preview could not be built.
schematics_previewTruncated: The preview ends here. Long lists are shortened as well.
schematics_errRead: Could not read this file as NBT.
schematics_errSize: This file is too large to convert in the browser. The limit is {limit} MiB.
schematics_report_dataVersionMissing: The file had no data version, set to {to}
schematics_report_blockMissingReplaced: Block {name} does not exist in 1.20.1 and was replaced with air
schematics_report_blockMissingKept: Block {name} does not exist in 1.20.1 and will load as air
schematics_report_modPalette: Blocks from the mod "{namespace}" are in the palette, {count} in total, and are not checked against 1.20.1
schematics_report_blockEntityWithoutId: Dropped a block entity without an id
schematics_report_blockEntityStripped: Stripped {id} block entity data down to its id
schematics_report_createUnverified: create:{name} has no specific rules and was converted generically, unverified
schematics_report_modBlockEntityUnverifi: {id} is a block entity from another mod and was converted generically, unverified
schematics_report_sequenceDropped: {id}: the sequenced gearshift program cannot be converted and was dropped
schematics_report_entityDroppedUnknown: Dropped an entity without an id
schematics_report_itemsConverted: Converted item stacks, count and components to Count and tag
schematics_report_fluidsConverted: Converted fluid stacks, id and amount to Variant and Amount
schematics_report_componentsDropped: Dropped data components on block entities and entities
schematics_report_attributeFilterDropped: The attribute filter {item} lost its matched attributes, which cannot be converted
schematics_report_blockPosConverted: Converted block position arrays to X, Y, Z compounds ({key})
schematics_report_blockPosConvertedInLis: Converted block position arrays to X, Y, Z compounds (list entry)
services_uploaderBody: Opens the uploader signed in as your Minecraft profile. We make you a link that works once and only for the next few minutes, so nobody else can walk into your library.
services_uploaderNeedsLink: The uploader signs you in as your Minecraft profile, so there has to be one linked first.
admin_serversIntro: What the public API and, eventually, the launcher read.
admin_tokensIntro: Credentials for the server plugins. Issue one per server so a leaked config file cannot rewrite another server's statistics.
admin_serverIdHint: The internal id the plugins already use, like i5. It cannot be changed later.
admin_serverExtraHint: JSON. Anything the launcher needs that this form does not cover yet. Set "webmap" to the address of the server's web map, starting with https://, and it is listed under Services.
admin_serverDeleteWarning: Deleting a server also deletes every statistic recorded for it. Set it to Archived instead if you only want it out of the way.
admin_assetsHint: Upload icons and backgrounds here and use the address next to each one wherever an image URL is needed, such as the launcher's pack JSON. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to {size}.
admin_assetsEmpty: No images uploaded for this server yet.
admin_assetNameHint: Optional. Defaults to the file's own name. Uploading over a name that is already here replaces that image and keeps its address.
admin_assetsAfterCreate: Images are uploaded on the server's own page, once it exists.
error_asset_too_large: That file is too big. The limit is 8 MB.
error_unsupported_asset_type: That kind of file cannot be uploaded. Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
error_asset_type_mismatch: That file is not the kind of image its name and type say it is.
error_invalid_asset_filename: That file name cannot be used. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
error_asset_not_found: That image is not there any more.
admin_tokenNameHint: Who holds this token. Shown only in this list.
admin_tokenServerHint: Recommended. A token pinned to one server cannot touch another server's data.
admin_tokenSecretBody: This is the only time the token is shown. It is stored as a hash, so it cannot be recovered later.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error_no_refresh_token: Sign in did not complete: the account system did not issue a refresh token. The OAuth client for this service needs the refresh_token grant and the offline_access scope.
error_insufficient_role: You do not have access to this.
error_account_already_linked: Your account already has a Minecraft profile linked. Unlink it first.
error_profile_already_linked: That Minecraft profile is already linked to another smto.dev account.
error_not_linked: There is no linked profile to remove.
error_uploader_disabled: The uploader is not available right now.
error_uploader_unavailable: The uploader did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error_invalid_code: That code is not valid any more. Get a new one and try again.
error_msa_linking_disabled: Microsoft linking is not set up on this server right now.
error_msa_no_xbox_account: That Microsoft account has no Xbox profile yet. Create one at xbox.com, or use the in-game code instead.
error_msa_region_unavailable: Xbox Live is not available in that account's country.
error_msa_adult_verification_required: That account needs adult verification before it can be used.
error_msa_child_account: That account belongs to a child and has to be added to a family by an adult first.
error_msa_does_not_own_game: That Microsoft account does not own Minecraft Java Edition.
error_msa_no_minecraft_profile: That account owns Minecraft but has not created a profile yet. Start the game once, pick a name, then come back.
error_msa_minecraft_login_failed: Minecraft would not confirm that account. Please try again, or use the in-game code.
error_msa_xbox_authentication_failed: Xbox Live would not confirm that account. Please try again later.
error_msa_token_exchange_failed: The Microsoft sign in did not complete. Please try again.
error_unknown_state: That link has expired. Please start again.
error_profile_message_invalid: That message is too long. Keep it to 80 characters.
error_account_not_linked: Link a Minecraft profile first, then you can leave a message.
error_server_already_exists: A server with that id already exists.
error_validation_failed: Please check the form and try again.
error_account_system_unreachable: The smto.dev account system is not reachable right now. Please try again in a moment.
